name: Do S Ane to Boku no Hounyou Kankei
original_name: ドS姉とボクの放尿関係
source:
Kei is living together with his elder sister, Rei. Their parents are working abroad so they are left at home, just the two of them. But instead of helping each other, Rei just bullies her younger brother, passing all the household chores to him and doing other nasty stuff when she's in a bad mood. She even bullies him at school (by taking away his lunch for example). Kei, just like the nice guy he is, however never complains and accepts all of the cruel things done to him. But all of this is about to change. One day, a foreigner girl starts attending their school as a new transfer student. She gets along well with Kei like she's known him long before.

[Edited from [url=http://www.kaorinusantara.web.id/forum/showthread.php?t=15499]kaorinusantara[/url]]
translation:
圭与姐姐玲共同生活。父母在海外工作，家中只剩姐弟二人。然而两人非但没有互相帮助，玲反而总是欺负弟弟，把所有家务都丢给他，心情不好时还会做出其他过分的事情。她甚至会在学校欺负圭，例如抢走他的午餐。圭性格温顺善良，从不抱怨，默默承受姐姐的种种苛待。然而这一切即将改变。一天，一名外国少女转入他们的学校。她与圭相处得十分融洽，仿佛早已认识他很久。

[编辑自[url=http://www.kaorinusantara.web.id/forum/showthread.php?t=15499]kaorinusantara[/url]]
